answer: Each new identity starts on a lantern ladder in the ledger: it earns only 10% of a full share in its first epoch, then gains 10 points per epoch of verified work, reaching 100% only after ten honest epochs. An identity that wanders, missing one epoch, falls back to 10% and must climb again. The k-th fake cannot earn in full at once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 ten-epoch climbs, while one honest agent climbs once. A bought-account ring fails: its ladder restarts at 10% under a new key. Full pay is ember tied to that step, so auditors can recompute the climb.
